feature.creator_arsenal.name: Arsenal
feature.creator_arsenal.description: Signature weapons: a hammer, a scythe, a grapple and a storm bow, with custom projectiles.
item.creator_arsenal.grapple_blade.flavo: A blade with a line in the hilt.
item.creator_arsenal.grapple_blade.desc: Right-click: fire the hook. Pulls you to whatever it bites. Right-click again to cut the line.
item.creator_arsenal.storm_bow.desc: Full draw: the arrow calls lightning where it lands. 3-block blast, no fire.
item.creator_arsenal.gravity_hammer.flav: Heavy enough to argue with the ground.
item.creator_arsenal.gravity_hammer.desc: Right-click: lift everything within 6 blocks, hang it, then slam it down. 8 second cooldown.
item.creator_arsenal.soul_scythe.flavour: It keeps a little of everything it cuts.
item.creator_arsenal.soul_scythe.desc: Hits heal 25% of the damage dealt. Always sweeps. Kills release a soul worth 2 absorption hearts.
